scope: Exact checkout-prefix replacements requested by the owner; preserve hash-bound evidence and raw native observations as explicitly selected by the owner.
historical_output_semantics: The 158 normalized historical files are presentation copies. Their original bytes remain available at source_revision. Changed path text must not be cited as verbatim original command output. Command results, approvals and verifier pins are not regenerated.
replacement: Repository checkout prefix becomes ./; paths are repository-root-relative.
check_log_note: Digests identify the actual temporary command logs observed during this pass; the logs are not embedded or claimed to be repository artifacts.

wiki_checks.command: pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts know fingerprints .. ../wiki
pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts know stamp ../wiki --workspace ..
pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts know anchors ../wiki --workspace ..
pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts know validate ../wiki
pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/main.ts know status ../wiki --workspace ..

wiki_result.limitation: Fingerprint scan covers Python only; stamp compares Git HEAD, not dirty TypeScript or Markdown content.
